TikTok pixel fixture

This page installs the TikTok pixel loader for the pixel id ZENIUMFIX01: the ttq queue on the window, a page call on it, and analytics.tiktok.com/i18n/pixel/events.js?sdkid=ZENIUMFIX01 requested as a script. Pixel helpers (TikTok Pixel Helper) find the pixel by that request; the id is not a live pixel, so nothing is reported anywhere.
